---
params:
  Common_name: "petrale sole"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
  
  species_name <- params$Common_name
  section_name <- firstup(species_name)
  wcgbt_years = c(2003:2019, 2021:2025)
  hkl_years = c(2004:2019, 2021:2025)
  
  sub_data <- data |>
    dplyr::filter(Common_name == species_name)
  sources <- get_source(data = sub_data)
  data_to_show <- unique(sub_data$sources_to_use)
  assess <- assess_data_df |>
    dplyr::filter(species == species_name)
  ass_yr <- ifelse(
    is.na(assess$year) & assess$type == "data-limited",
    2010,
    assess$year
  )
  if (
    assess$type %in% c("benchmark", "update", "data-moderate", "data-limited")
  ) {
    a_an <- ifelse(assess$type == "update", "an", "a")
    assess_text <- glue::glue(
      'The most recent assessment of {species_name} ',
      'was {a_an} {assess$type} assessment conducted in {ass_yr}. '
    ) 
  } else {
    assess_text <- glue::glue(
      'To date, no assessment or analysis has been conducted on {species_name}. '
    )
  }
  
  obs_text <- glue::glue(
    "Across available data, {species_name} ",
    "have been observed and sampled by"
  )
  if (data_to_show == "all_plus") {
    survey_text <- glue::glue("{obs_text} commercial and recreational fisheries, the NWFWC HKLS, the NWFSC WCGBTS, and the CCFRP Survey. ") 
  }
  if (data_to_show == "all_plus_plus") {
     survey_text <- glue::glue("{obs_text} commercial and recreational fisheries, the GCDC, the NWFWC HKLS, the NWFSC WCGBTS, and the CCFRP Survery. ") 
  }
  if (data_to_show == "comm_wcgbt_rec") {
     survey_text <- glue::glue("{obs_text} commercial and recreational fisheries and the NWFSC WCGBTS.")
  }
  if (data_to_show == "ccfrp_comm_wcgbt_rec") {
     survey_text <- glue::glue("{obs_text} commercial and recreational fisheries, the NWFSC WCGBTS, and the CCFRP Survey. ") 
  }  
    if (data_to_show == "comm_wcgbt") {
     survey_text <- glue::glue("{obs_text} commercial fisheries and the NWFSC WCGBTS. ")
  } 
    if (data_to_show == "ccfrp_comm_hkl_wcgbt") {
     survey_text <- glue::glue("{obs_text} commercial fisheries, the NWFWC HKLS, the NWFSC WCGBTS, and the CCFRP Survey. ") 
  }
  
  average_sets <- sub_data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      n = dplyr::case_when(
        Source == "NWFSC WCGBTS" ~ length(wcgbt_years),
        Source == "NWFSC HKLS" ~ length(hkl_years)
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(Source) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      y = unique(n),
      total = sum(set_tows),
      sets = round(sum(set_tows) / y, 0)
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()
  sample_text <- ""
  for (ss in average_sets$Source) {
    number <- average_sets[average_sets$Source == ss, "sets"]
    number_text <- ifelse(number < 1, "less than one", number)
    set_text <- ifelse(number < 2, "set", "sets")
    tow_text <- ifelse(number < 2, "tow", "tows")
    if (ss == "NWFSC HKLS") {
      samples <- glue::glue(
        "The {ss} observed {species_name} on an average of {number_text} {set_text} per year."
      )
      sample_text <- glue::glue("{sample_text} {samples}")
    }    
    if (ss == "NWFSC WCGBTS") {
      samples <- glue::glue(
        "The {ss} observed {species_name} on an average of {number_text} {tow_text} per year."
      )
      sample_text <- glue::glue("{sample_text} {samples}")
    }
  }

  age_validation_text <- ""  
  if (species_name %in% c("longspine thornyhead", "shortspine thornyhead")) { 
    age_validation_text <- glue::glue(
      "{age_validation_text} No validated (accurate and precise) ageing methology currently exists for {species_name}. "
    )
  }
  if (species_name == "bocaccio") { 
    age_validation_text <- glue::glue(
      "{age_validation_text} {firstup(species_name)} otoliths are very difficult to read for age estimation,
      particularly for {species_name} in the California Bight area. Currently, ageing staff at the Cooperative Ageing
      Program lab do not have an ageing protocol for this species. Due to these challenges, no ageing effort is anticipated. "
    )
  }
  if(species_name ==  "yellowtail rockfish south") {
    age_validation_text <- glue::glue("The Cooperative Ageing Program lab has aged 1,271 otoliths collected by the NWFSC HKLS that
      are not represented in the count of aged fish shown.")
  }
  if(species_name ==  "redbanded rockfish") {
    age_validation_text <- glue::glue("The Cooperative Ageing Program lab has aged an additional 703 otoliths collected by the NWFSC WCGBTS that
      are not represented in the count of aged fish shown.")
  }
  # Get maturity
  mat <- maturity |>
    dplyr::filter(Species == species_name)
  if (dim(mat)[1] != 0) {
    count <- mat$Count
    read <- mat$Read
  } else {
    count <- 0
    read <- 0
  }
  if (count > 0) { 
  mat_text <- glue::glue("For this species, a total of {count} maturity samples have been collected coastwide (regardless of stock area), with {read} read maturities.")
  }
  if (count == 0) { 
  mat_text <- glue::glue("For this species, a total of {count} maturity samples have been collected coastwide (regardless of stock area).")
  }
  
  maturity_parameters_text <- maturity_parameters_list(species_name = species_name)
  
  research_text <- research_list(species_name = species_name)
  
  total_text <- glue::glue("{assess_text} {survey_text} {sample_text} {age_validation_text} {mat_text} {maturity_parameters_text} {research_text}")

```

```{r}
table_caption <- glue::glue("Total number of available lengths, read ages, and unread age structures by data source and
 	state for {species_name}.")

```


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| tbl-cap: !expr table_caption
#| tbl-pos: H

if (species_name != "widow rockfish") {
  sub_data |>
    dplyr::group_by(State, Source) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      Lengths = sum(total_lengths),
      Ages = sum(total_ages),
      `Age Structures` = sum(total_otoliths)
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::fmt_number(
      columns = 3:5,
      decimals = 0
    ) |>
    gt::tab_options(
      table.font.size = 12,
      footnotes.font.size = 12,
      # if want to not have tables the width of the page include the below option:
      latex.use_longtable = TRUE 
    ) |>
    gt::cols_align(
        align = "right"
    ) |>
    gt::cols_width(
       `Source` ~ px(140)
    ) |>
    gt::as_latex()
} else {
  sub_data |>
    dplyr::group_by(State, Source) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      Lengths = sum(total_lengths),
      Ages = sum(total_ages),
      `Age Structures` = sum(total_otoliths)
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::fmt_number(
      columns = 3:5,
      decimals = 0
    ) |>
    gt::tab_options(
      table.font.size = 12,
      footnotes.font.size = 12,
      # if want to not have tables the width of the page include the below option:
      latex.use_longtable = TRUE 
    ) |>
    gt::cols_align(
      align = "right"
    ) |>
    gt::cols_width(
       `Source` ~ px(140)
    ) |>
    gt::tab_footnote(
      footnote = "Out of the 3,352 total ages from California Commercial collections, 1,884 ages were available and used in the 2025 stock assessment.",
      locations = gt::cells_column_labels(columns = Ages)
    )|>
    gt::as_latex()
}
```
